units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39">Gen. R. s. 39</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 45:12">Ps. XLV, 12</cite>) <he>ליַפּוֹתָיךְ בעולם</he> to make thee popular in the world.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 9:10">Ned. IX, 10</cite> <he>יִיפּוּהָ</he> they improved her appearance.
Ber. 43ᵇ (ref. to Koh. III, 11) שי׳ הקב״ה אומנתו בפני כל וא׳ א׳ Ms. M. (differ. in ed.), v. אוּמָנוּת.—Part. pass. מְיוּפֶּה adorned, elaborate.
Cant. R. to I, 1 נמצא מי׳ ומרובה וכ׳ was Solomon’s palace more elaborate and extensive than the Temple?—2) to improve (land).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:20">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ</cite> top <he>קצר ליַיפּוֹת וכ׳</he> he cut the grass for the sake of improving the land.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:20">Ib.</cite> <he>חייב משום מְיַיפֶּה וכ׳</he> he is guilty of the offence of improving the land on the Sabbath. Pesik. S’liḥoth, p. 166ᵃ <he>יַפֵּה כחך</he> improve thy strength (by practicing).

senses.gloss: (with כח) to strengthen one’s rights, to confer prerogatives.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 7:2">B. Bath. VII, 2</cite> <he>ליַיפּוֹת כחו של מוכר</he> to give the seller the prerogative. Y. ib. VIII, 16ᵃ top <he>יִיפִּיתָה כחה בנכסי האם</he> thou hast (the Law has) given her a prerogative with reference to her mother’s property; a. fr.

Peah VI, 6 [read:] יופה כחו של וכ׳ (Ms. M. ייפיה, ed. יופי) the prerogative of the owner has been made firmer, opp. הורע.—Part. מְיוּפֶּה (v. supra). Y. Gitt. II, beg. 44ᵃ חתימה … כחו מי׳ by two persons testifying to the signature her case is improved.
<cite ref="Taanit 23b:13">Taan. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>תִּתְיַיפִּי חנה</he> Hannah, grow handsome, <he>ונִתְיַיפְּתָה</he> Ms. M. (ed. … <he>פָּת</he>) and she did &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 59">Gen. R. s. 59</cite> <he>נִתְיַיפִּיתָ וכ׳</he> thou (Abraham) hast been praised among the angels &c.
